test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The table given below shows the marks obtained by five students in 4 different subjects. Maximum marks for each subject is 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33a204214eb7dcf39be899420e38b6ca9f5fbcba7a2d4a260546fbfcc510ed4b.png] 

What is the average of total marks obtained by all five students in subject V?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total marks in subject V = 64 + 76 + 64 + 71 + 69 = 344

Average marks = Total marks / Number of students = 344 / 5 = 68.8

The average marks obtained by all five students in subject V is 68.8.
